page: Amazon Web Services r8gn.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized instance powered by AWS Graviton arm64 processors. The server is configured with 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz without simultaneous multithreading, providing 96 total vCPUs. System memory reaches 768.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per core ratio tailored for memory-intensive operational footprints.

Hardware connectivity includes a baseline network throughput of 300 Gbps, enabling high-speed node-to-node communication and remote storage integration. The server includes no bundled local storage and features zero GPUs, directing all persistent storage input/output over the network. Direct bare-metal hardware access bypasses hypervisor layers, allowing workloads to use the underlying arm64 hardware without virtualization overhead.

The 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio combined with substantial network throughput makes this instance profile viable for high-capacity in-memory databases, distributed memory caching, real-time stream processing, and large data transformation pipelines. Because local disk volumes are omitted, resource efficiency relies on pairing compute and memory density with network-attached storage architectures.
